noise_definition: max minus min of the teacher's two scores over the items both runs scored, the gate's run-to-run noise rule applied to the teacher

conditions.other_chip_note: the teacher arm scored on a Colab NVIDIA A100, not the lab's Strix Halo pods; the score depends on the teacher's outputs, not on the chip, and the cross-chip record below is the equivalence evidence
conditions.vllm_source: stock wheel from PyPI, no build, no patch
conditions.serve: python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model /content/models/Qwen3.8-27B-INT4 --served-model-name teacher group-brain --port 8000 --host 127.0.0.1 --scheduling-policy priority --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --max-model-len 16384 --limit-mm-per-prompt {"image":1} --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --dtype bfloat16 --override-generation-config {"top_k":1} --default-chat-template-kwargs {"enable_thinking":false}
conditions.decode_attestation: greedy from the server default top_k 1 and thinking off from the server default chat-template kwarg, both checked before scoring by decode_probe (repeats identical, equal to an explicit temperature 0 top_k 1 thinking-off request, no thinking text)
conditions.equivalence: R57 cross-chip correctness record fixtures/lab/bench/a100-2026-10-10/vllm-a100-2026-10-10.json (PR #306, branch ctx/runtime/a100-reference, commit d1fb76f), same checkpoint and greedy settings as the Strix Halo baseline fixtures/lab/correctness/vllm-gfx1151-2026-10-11.json: text-kitchen matches all 128 tokens, text-schedule diverges at token 76, image-shapes at token 3, image-bars at token 0
